recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The seed request is satisfied in the current built specification; any future cleanup of the source id/url convention should be handled as a publisher/source-model refactor, not as a FHIR-37812 correction.
issue_request: FHIR-37812 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6. It requested that the DeviceAssociation.subject patient search use the common http://hl7.org/fhir/SearchParameter/clinical-patient parameter, include DeviceAssociation.subject.where(resolve() is Patient), and no longer expose an unused DeviceAssociation-patient canonical search parameter.
initial_application: Commit f8251515a3 added DeviceAssociation to source/searchparameter/common-search-parameters.xml under clinical-patient. That initial Jira-tagged application did not touch the DeviceAssociation search-parameter bundle, but current source also contains a DeviceAssociation patient row that supplies the resource-specific expression and Patient target used by the build.
additional_context: DeviceAssociation is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied issue FHIR-46973 re-added/clarified the DeviceAssociation patient search row after the patient parameter had disappeared or was incorrect, which explains why a resource-local source row remains even though the generated canonical search parameter is common. Current CI output maps that row to clinical-patient and does not expose DeviceAssociation-patient as a separate canonical search parameter.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because removing the local DeviceAssociation-patient source row would remove the input currently used to generate the DeviceAssociation expression for the common clinical-patient parameter.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied DeviceAssociation search-parameter issue that added/clarified the patient row, supporting the conclusion that the local source row should remain while generating common clinical-patient.
